verdict.rationale: Cognee's `.improve` operation enriches an existing graph after ingestion and `.forget` supports single-item or full dataset deletion, giving some update/removal machinery, but no documentation explicitly describes contradiction detection, automatic supersession, or merging of conflicting facts within the graph — updates rely on manual re-ingestion or deletion rather than a first-class 'resolve conflicting memory' mechanism. missing for 10: explicit contradiction-detection logic, automatic merge/supersede semantics when new facts conflict with stored ones, and independent evidence/benchmarks showing this behavior in practice.
